scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply constellation-study --local --env local
scripts.db:seed: wrangler d1 execute constellation-study --local --env local --file data/seed.sql
scripts.deploy: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && wrangler deploy --env=""
scripts.format: prettier --write "src/**/*.{js,jsx,ts,css}" "worker/**/*.ts" "scripts/*.mjs" "tests/*.{ts,mjs}" vite.config.js index.html package.json tsconfig.json wrangler.jsonc
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "src/**/*.{js,jsx,ts,css}" "worker/**/*.ts" "scripts/*.mjs" "tests/*.{ts,mjs}" vite.config.js index.html package.json tsconfig.json wrangler.jsonc
